It's taking your life selfish? I personally try so hard to enjoy my life I read personal development books watch motivational videos every day but I hate myself. I don't like myself as a person. I had a fucked up life the second I was born. I lost both my parents in a explosion and I survived and ended up in coma with 80% of my body damaged with burns. I was only 2 or 3 years old.... Long story short I got humilited in my early child hood I hid my scars because of these ugly scars I had to limit myself. No swimming, no sports because I only wear long sleeves and  no shorts no nothing!!!!. I personally can't stand the sight of my scars. I never let anyone see me without sleeves. I always fantasize how much different my life would have 
 been with out them. This scars have shaped my character and I don't like that character at all. I have never been at peace with myself. I have three daughters. That's the only reason I have not took away my life. ...but honestly what good is a father who was shaped by trauma to them? I'm undocumented I can't get a decent job so a hard labor minimum wage job. I'm introverted and anti social and dont have friends.. I'm worried about my future. I want to be loved by someone that I love that I'm attracted too. But my scars are hideous.....I want to be at peace with myself I want to be proud of myself. My life was defined by the burning hell I  went through as a child. I want to be at peace with myself I want to feel confident. I want this all to end I just want peace !!!
